description: Run Antigravity CLI in BB with persistent thread instructions, tip forking, manual compaction, and a live Swarm board. Pick CLI-discovered models with low through max reasoning, isolate each thread in its own worker process, and track per-model quota windows. Built-in health checks verify sign-in and run CLI installs or updates on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Requires Antigravity CLI 1.5.0+ and a signed-in Google account on the host.
